item.title: Forum Crit Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Author, per the new required reading forum guidelines: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas please fill out the new concept template to seek feedback on your idea.

Remember to please edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your first comment rather than creating a new thread.

Once you have revised your post accordingly, please reach out to reviewers to request that they look at your thread. You can find a list of ways to contact reviewers in this thread: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: Mosquito idea greenlight request
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article
Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional
Elevator Pitch: scp finds people made of mosquitoes and mistakes them for hostile entities.
Central Narrative: Basically In the 70s the scp foundation was taking out cults to protect the veil and contain anything they created. They find people made of mosquitoes and classify them as hostile. Later they find one raised by a normal family and they are sane and not hostile. Reclassified as humanoid non hostile.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: its a take on the don't judge a book by its cover idea.
Additional Notes:
Told in interview logs.
